definitions.explanation: The vacation period during winter, typically from late December to early January for schools, and around the New Year period for workplaces.

examples.japanese: {冬休|ふゆやす}みが{始|はじ}まった。
{冬休|ふゆやす}みに{家族|かぞく}で{旅行|りょこう}する{予定|よてい}です。
examples.english: I plan to travel with my family during winter break.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたちは{冬休|ふゆやす}みの{宿題|しゅくだい}をまだ{終|お}わらせていない。
examples.english: The children still haven't finished their winter break homework.

notes: In Japan, school winter break typically runs from late December to early January (about two weeks), shorter than {夏休|なつやす}み. It overlaps with {年末年始|ねんまつねんし} (year-end and New Year period). Compare with {夏休|なつやす}み (summer vacation) and {春休|はるやす}み (spring break).
